verses.isaiah 15:4: Isaiah 15:4 Heshbon and Elealeh will cry out, Their voice shall be heard as far as Jahaz; Therefore the armed soldiers of Moab will cry out; His life will be burdensome to him.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 15:5: Isaiah 15:5 "My  heart will cry out for Moab; His fugitives shall flee to Zoar, Like a three-year-old heifer. For by the Ascent of Luhith They will go up with weeping; For in the way of Horonaim They will raise up a cry of destruction,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 15:6: Isaiah 15:6 For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate, For the green grass has withered away; The grass fails, there is nothing green.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 15:7: Isaiah 15:7 Therefore the abundance they have gained, And what they have laid up, They will carry away to the Brook of the Willows.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 15:8: Isaiah 15:8 For the cry has gone all around the borders of Moab, Its wailing to Eglaim And its wailing to Beer Elim.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 15:9: Isaiah 15:9 For the waters of Dimon will be full of blood; Because I will bring more upon Dimon,  Lions upon him who escapes from Moab, And on the remnant of the land."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:1: Isaiah 16:1 Send the lamb to the ruler of the land,  From Sela to the wilderness, To the mount of the daughter of Zion.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:2: Isaiah 16:2 For it shall be as a wandering bird thrown out of the nest; So shall be the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:3: Isaiah 16:3 "Take counsel, execute judgment; Make your shadow like the night in the middle of the day; Hide the outcasts, Do not betray him who escapes.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:4: Isaiah 16:4 Let My outcasts dwell with you, O Moab; Be a shelter to them from the face of the spoiler. For the extortioner is at an end, Devastation ceases, The oppressors are consumed out of the land.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:5: Isaiah 16:5 In mercy the throne will be established; And One will sit on it in truth, in the tabernacle of David,  Judging and seeking justice and hastening righteousness."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:6: Isaiah 16:6 We have heard of the pride of Moab"” He is very proud"” Of his haughtiness and his pride and his wrath;  But his lies shall not be so.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:7: Isaiah 16:7 Therefore Moab shall wail for Moab; Everyone shall wail. For the foundations of Kir Hareseth you shall mourn; Surely they are stricken.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:8: Isaiah 16:8 For the fields of Heshbon languish, And the vine of Sibmah; The lords of the nations have broken down its choice plants, Which have reached to Jazer And wandered through the wilderness. Her branches are stretched out, They are gone over the sea.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:9: Isaiah 16:9 Therefore I will bewail the vine of Sibmah, With the weeping of Jazer; I will drench you with my tears,  O Heshbon and Elealeh; For battle cries have fallen Over your summer fruits and your harvest.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:10: Isaiah 16:10 Gladness is taken away, And joy from the plentiful field; In the vineyards there will be no singing, Nor will there be shouting; No treaders will tread out wine in the presses; I have made their shouting cease.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:11: Isaiah 16:11 Therefore my heart shall resound like a harp for Moab, And my inner being for Kir Heres.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:12: Isaiah 16:12 And it shall come to pass, When it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, That he will come to his sanctuary to pray; But he will not prevail.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:13: Isaiah 16:13 This is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning Moab since that time.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 16:14: Isaiah 16:14 But now the LORD has spoken, saying, "Within three years, as the years of a hired man, the glory of Moab will be despised with all that great multitude, and the remnant will be very small and feeble."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:1: Isaiah 17:1 The burden against Damascus. "Behold, Damascus will cease from being a city, And it will be a ruinous heap.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:2: Isaiah 17:2 The cities of Aroer are forsaken; They will be for flocks Which lie down, and no one will make them afraid.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:3: Isaiah 17:3 The fortress also will cease from Ephraim, The kingdom from Damascus, And the remnant of Syria; They will be as the glory of the children of Israel," Says the LORD of hosts.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:4: Isaiah 17:4 "In that day it shall come to pass That the glory of Jacob will wane, And the fatness of his flesh grow lean.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:5: Isaiah 17:5 It shall be as when the harvester gathers the grain, And reaps the heads with his arm; It shall be as he who gathers heads of grain In the Valley of Rephaim.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:6: Isaiah 17:6 Yet gleaning grapes will be left in it, Like the shaking of an olive tree, Two or three olives at the top of the uppermost bough, Four or five in its most fruitful branches," Says the LORD God of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:7: Isaiah 17:7 In that day a man will look to his Maker, And his eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:8: Isaiah 17:8 He will not look to the altars, The work of his hands; He will not respect what his fingers have made, Nor the wooden images nor the incense altars.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:9: Isaiah 17:9 In that day his strong cities will be as a forsaken bough And an uppermost branch, Which they left because of the children of Israel; And there will be desolation.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:10: Isaiah 17:10 Because you have forgotten the God of your salvation, And have not been mindful of the Rock of your stronghold, Therefore you will plant pleasant plants And set out foreign seedlings;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:11: Isaiah 17:11 In the day you will make your plant to grow, And in the morning you will make your seed to flourish; But the harvest will be a heap of ruins In the day of grief and desperate sorrow.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:12: Isaiah 17:12 Woe to the multitude of many people Who make a noise like the roar of the seas, And to the rushing of nations That make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:13: Isaiah 17:13 The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters; But God will rebuke them and they will flee far away, And be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, Like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 17:14: Isaiah 17:14 Then behold, at eventide, trouble! And before the morning, he is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, And the lot of those who rob us.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:1: Isaiah 18:1 Woe to the land shadowed with buzzing wings, Which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:2: Isaiah 18:2 Which sends ambassadors by sea, Even in vessels of reed on the waters, saying, "Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth of skin, To a people terrible from their beginning onward, A nation powerful and treading down, Whose land the rivers divide."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:3: Isaiah 18:3 All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on the earth:  When he lifts up a banner on the mountains, you see it; And when he blows a trumpet, you hear it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:4: Isaiah 18:4 For so the LORD said to me, "I will take My rest, And I will look from My dwelling place Like clear heat in sunshine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:5: Isaiah 18:5 For before the harvest, when the bud is perfect And the sour grape is ripening in the flower, He will both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks And take away and cut down the branches.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:6: Isaiah 18:6 They will be left together for the mountain birds of prey And for the beasts of the earth; The birds of prey will summer on them, And all the beasts of the earth will winter on them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 18:7: Isaiah 18:7 In that time a present will be brought to the LORD of hosts From a people tall and smooth of skin, And from a people terrible from their beginning onward, A nation powerful and treading down, Whose land the rivers divide"” To the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, To Mount Zion.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:1: Isaiah 19:1 The burden against Egypt. Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, And will come into Egypt;  The idols of Egypt will totter at His presence, And the heart of Egypt will melt in its midst.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:2: Isaiah 19:2 "I will set Egyptians against Egyptians; Everyone will fight against his brother, And everyone against his neighbor, City against city, kingdom against kingdom.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:3: Isaiah 19:3 The spirit of Egypt will fail in its midst; I will destroy their counsel, And they will consult the idols and the charmers, The mediums and the sorcerers.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:4: Isaiah 19:4 And the Egyptians I will give  Into the hand of a cruel master, And a fierce king will rule over them," Says the Lord, the LORD of hosts.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:5: Isaiah 19:5 The waters will fail from the sea, And the river will be wasted and dried up.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:6: Isaiah 19:6 The rivers will turn foul; The brooks of defense will be emptied and dried up; The reeds and rushes will wither.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:7: Isaiah 19:7 The papyrus reeds by the River, by the mouth of the River, And everything sown by the River, Will wither, be driven away, and be no more.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:8: Isaiah 19:8 The fishermen also will mourn; All those will lament who cast hooks into the River, And they will languish who spread nets on the waters.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:9: Isaiah 19:9 Moreover those who work in fine flax And those who weave fine fabric will be ashamed;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:10: Isaiah 19:10 And its foundations will be broken. All who make wages will be troubled of soul.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:11: Isaiah 19:11 Surely the princes of Zoan are fools; Pharaoh's wise counselors give foolish counsel.  How do you say to Pharaoh, "I am the son of the wise, The son of ancient kings?"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:12: Isaiah 19:12 Where are they? Where are your wise men? Let them tell you now, And let them know what the LORD of hosts has purposed against Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:13: Isaiah 19:13 The princes of Zoan have become fools;  The princes of Noph are deceived; They have also deluded Egypt, Those who are the mainstay of its tribes.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:14: Isaiah 19:14 The LORD has mingled a perverse spirit in her midst; And they have caused Egypt to err in all her work, As a drunken man staggers in his vomit.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:15: Isaiah 19:15 Neither will there be any work for Egypt, Which the head or tail, Palm branch or bulrush, may do.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:16: Isaiah 19:16 In that day Egypt will be like women, and will be afraid and fear because of the waving of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which He waves over it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:17: Isaiah 19:17 And the land of Judah will be a terror to Egypt; everyone who makes mention of it will be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts which He has determined against it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:18: Isaiah 19:18 In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear by the LORD of hosts; one will be called the City of Destruction.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:19: Isaiah 19:19 In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:20: Isaiah 19:20 And it will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of the oppressors, and He will send them a Savior and a Mighty One, and He will deliver them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:21: Isaiah 19:21 Then the LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day, and will make sacrifice and offering; yes, they will make a vow to the LORD and perform it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:22: Isaiah 19:22 And the LORD will strike Egypt, He will strike and heal it; they will return to the LORD, and He will be entreated by them and heal them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:23: Isaiah 19:23 In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian will come into Egypt and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians will serve with the Assyrians.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:24: Isaiah 19:24 In that day Israel will be one of three with Egypt and Assyria"”a blessing in the midst of the land,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 19:25: Isaiah 19:25 whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, "Blessed is Egypt My people, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:1: Isaiah 20:1 In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:2: Isaiah 20:2 at the same time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, "Go, and remove the sackcloth from your body, and take your sandals off your feet." And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:3: Isaiah 20:3 Then the LORD said, "Just as My servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder against Egypt and Ethiopia,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:4: Isaiah 20:4 so shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians as prisoners and the Ethiopians as captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:5: Isaiah 20:5 Then they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation and Egypt their glory.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 20:6: Isaiah 20:6 And the inhabitant of this territory will say in that day, "˜Surely such is our expectation, wherever we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria; and how shall we escape?' "(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:1: Isaiah 21:1 The burden against the Wilderness of the Sea. As whirlwinds in the South pass through, So it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:2: Isaiah 21:2 A distressing vision is declared to me;  The treacherous dealer deals treacherously, And the plunderer plunders.  Go up, O Elam! Besiege, O Media! All its sighing I have made to cease.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:3: Isaiah 21:3 Therefore my loins are filled with pain;  Pangs have taken hold of me, like the pangs of a woman in labor. I was distressed when I heard it; I was dismayed when I saw it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:4: Isaiah 21:4 My heart wavered, fearfulness frightened me;  The night for which I longed He turned into fear for me.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:5: Isaiah 21:5 Prepare the table, Set a watchman in the tower, Eat and drink. Arise, you princes, Anoint the shield!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:6: Isaiah 21:6 For thus has the Lord said to me: "Go, set a watchman, Let him declare what he sees."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:7: Isaiah 21:7 And he saw a chariot with a pair of horsemen, A chariot of donkeys, and a chariot of camels, And he listened earnestly with great care.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:8: Isaiah 21:8 Then he cried, "A lion, my Lord! I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime; I have sat at my post every night.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:9: Isaiah 21:9 And look, here comes a chariot of men with a pair of horsemen!" Then he answered and said,  "Babylon is fallen, is fallen! And all the carved images of her gods He has broken to the ground."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:10: Isaiah 21:10 Oh, my threshing and the grain of my floor! That which I have heard from the LORD of hosts, The God of Israel, I have declared to you.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:11: Isaiah 21:11 The burden against Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, "Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:12: Isaiah 21:12 The watchman said, "The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; Return! Come back!"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:13: Isaiah 21:13 The burden against Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, O you traveling companies of Dedanites.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:14: Isaiah 21:14 O inhabitants of the land of Tema, Bring water to him who is thirsty; With their bread they met him who fled.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:15: Isaiah 21:15 For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, From the bent bow, and from the distress of war.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:16: Isaiah 21:16 For thus the LORD has said to me: "Within a year, according to the year of a hired man, all the glory of Kedar will fail;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 21:17: Isaiah 21:17 and the remainder of the number of archers, the mighty men of the people of Kedar, will be diminished; for the LORD God of Israel has spoken it."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:1: Isaiah 22:1 The burden against the Valley of Vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:2: Isaiah 22:2 You who are full of noise, A tumultuous city, a joyous city? Your slain men are not slain with the sword, Nor dead in battle.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:3: Isaiah 22:3 All your rulers have fled together; They are captured by the archers. All who are found in you are bound together; They have fled from afar.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:4: Isaiah 22:4 Therefore I said, "Look away from me,  I will weep bitterly; Do not labor to comfort me Because of the plundering of the daughter of my people."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:5: Isaiah 22:5 For it is a day of trouble and treading down and perplexity  By the Lord GOD of hosts In the Valley of Vision"” Breaking down the walls And of crying to the mountain.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:6: Isaiah 22:6 Elam bore the quiver With chariots of men and horsemen, And Kir uncovered the shield.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:7: Isaiah 22:7 It shall come to pass that your choicest valleys Shall be full of chariots, And the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:8: Isaiah 22:8 He removed the protection of Judah. You looked in that day to the armor of the House of the Forest;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:9: Isaiah 22:9 You also saw the damage to the city of David, That it was great; And you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:10: Isaiah 22:10 You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, And the houses you broke down To fortify the wall.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:11: Isaiah 22:11 You also made a reservoir between the two walls For the water of the old pool. But you did not look to its Maker, Nor did you have respect for Him who fashioned it long ago.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:12: Isaiah 22:12 And in that day the Lord GOD of hosts  Called for weeping and for mourning,  For baldness and for girding with sackcloth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:13: Isaiah 22:13 But instead, joy and gladness, Slaying oxen and killing sheep, Eating meat and drinking wine:  "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:14: Isaiah 22:14 Then it was revealed in my hearing by the LORD of hosts, "Surely for this iniquity there will be no atonement for you, Even to your death," says the Lord GOD of hosts.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:15: Isaiah 22:15 Thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: "Go, proceed to this steward, To Shebna, who is over the house, and say:(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:16: Isaiah 22:16 "˜What have you here, and whom have you here, That you have hewn a sepulcher here, As he who hews himself a sepulcher on high, Who carves a tomb for himself in a rock?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:17: Isaiah 22:17 Indeed, the LORD will throw you away violently, O mighty man,  And will surely seize you.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:18: Isaiah 22:18 He will surely turn violently and toss you like a ball Into a large country; There you shall die, and there your glorious chariots Shall be the shame of your master's house.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:19: Isaiah 22:19 So I will drive you out of your office, And from your position he will pull you down.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:20: Isaiah 22:20 "˜Then it shall be in that day, That I will call My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:21: Isaiah 22:21 I will clothe him with your robe And strengthen him with your belt; I will commit your responsibility into his hand. He shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem And to the house of Judah.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:22: Isaiah 22:22 The key of the house of David I will lay on his shoulder; So he shall open, and no one shall shut; And he shall shut, and no one shall open.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:23: Isaiah 22:23 I will fasten him as a peg in a secure place, And he will become a glorious throne to his father's house.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:24: Isaiah 22:24 "˜They will hang on him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the posterity, all vessels of small quantity, from the cups to all the pitchers.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 22:25: Isaiah 22:25 In that day,' says the LORD of hosts, "˜the peg that is fastened in the secure place will be removed and be cut down and fall, and the burden that was on it will be cut off; for the LORD has spoken.' "(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:1: Isaiah 23:1 The burden against Tyre. Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, So that there is no house, no harbor; From the land of Cyprus it is revealed to them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:2: Isaiah 23:2 Be still, you inhabitants of the coastland, You merchants of Sidon, Whom those who cross the sea have filled.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:3: Isaiah 23:3 And on great waters the grain of Shihor, The harvest of the River, is her revenue; And she is a marketplace for the nations.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:4: Isaiah 23:4 Be ashamed, O Sidon; For the sea has spoken, The strength of the sea, saying, "I do not labor, nor bring forth children; Neither do I rear young men, Nor bring up virgins."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:5: Isaiah 23:5 When the report reaches Egypt, They also will be in agony at the report of Tyre.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:6: Isaiah 23:6 Cross over to Tarshish; Wail, you inhabitants of the coastland!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:7: Isaiah 23:7 Is this your joyous city, Whose antiquity is from ancient days, Whose feet carried her far off to dwell?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:8: Isaiah 23:8 Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, Whose merchants are princes, Whose traders are the honorable of the earth?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:9: Isaiah 23:9 The LORD of hosts has purposed it, To bring to dishonor the pride of all glory, To bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:10: Isaiah 23:10 Overflow through your land like the River, O daughter of Tarshish; There is no more strength.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:11: Isaiah 23:11 He stretched out His hand over the sea, He shook the kingdoms; The LORD has given a commandment against Canaan To destroy its strongholds.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:12: Isaiah 23:12 And He said, "You will rejoice no more, O you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, cross over to Cyprus; There also you will have no rest."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:13: Isaiah 23:13 Behold, the land of the Chaldeans, This people which was not; Assyria founded it for wild beasts of the desert. They set up its towers, They raised up its palaces, And brought it to ruin.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:14: Isaiah 23:14 Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For your strength is laid waste.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:15: Isaiah 23:15 Now it shall come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:16: Isaiah 23:16 "Take a harp, go about the city, You forgotten harlot; Make sweet melody, sing many songs, That you may be remembered."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:17: Isaiah 23:17 And it shall be, at the end of seventy years, that the LORD will deal with Tyre. She will return to her hire, and commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 23:18: Isaiah 23:18 Her gain and her pay will be set apart for the LORD; it will not be treasured nor laid up, for her gain will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for fine clothing.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:1: Isaiah 24:1 Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty and makes it waste, Distorts its surface And scatters abroad its inhabitants.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:2: Isaiah 24:2 And it shall be: As with the people, so with the priest; As with the servant, so with his master; As with the maid, so with her mistress;  As with the buyer, so with the seller; As with the lender, so with the borrower; As with the creditor, so with the debtor.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:3: Isaiah 24:3 The land shall be entirely emptied and utterly plundered, For the LORD has spoken this word.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:4: Isaiah 24:4 The earth mourns and fades away, The world languishes and fades away; The haughty people of the earth languish.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:5: Isaiah 24:5 The earth is also defiled under its inhabitants, Because they have transgressed the laws, Changed the ordinance, Broken the everlasting covenant.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:6: Isaiah 24:6 Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, And those who dwell in it are desolate. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, And few men are left.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:7: Isaiah 24:7 The new wine fails, the vine languishes, All the merry-hearted sigh.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:8: Isaiah 24:8 The mirth of the tambourine ceases, The noise of the jubilant ends, The joy of the harp ceases.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:9: Isaiah 24:9 They shall not drink wine with a song; Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:10: Isaiah 24:10 The city of confusion is broken down; Every house is shut up, so that none may go in.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:11: Isaiah 24:11 There is a cry for wine in the streets, All joy is darkened, The mirth of the land is gone.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:12: Isaiah 24:12 In the city desolation is left, And the gate is stricken with destruction.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:13: Isaiah 24:13 When it shall be thus in the midst of the land among the people,  It shall be like the shaking of an olive tree, Like the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:14: Isaiah 24:14 They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing; For the majesty of the LORD They shall cry aloud from the sea.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:15: Isaiah 24:15 Therefore glorify the LORD in the dawning light,  The name of the LORD God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:16: Isaiah 24:16 From the ends of the earth we have heard songs: "Glory to the righteous!" But I said, "I am ruined, ruined! Woe to me!  The treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously, Indeed, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:17: Isaiah 24:17 Fear and the pit and the snare Are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:18: Isaiah 24:18 And it shall be That he who flees from the noise of the fear Shall fall into the pit, And he who comes up from the midst of the pit Shall be caught in the snare; For the windows from on high are open, And the foundations of the earth are shaken.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:19: Isaiah 24:19 The earth is violently broken, The earth is split open, The earth is shaken exceedingly.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:20: Isaiah 24:20 The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, And shall totter like a hut; Its transgression shall be heavy upon it, And it will fall, and not rise again.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:21: Isaiah 24:21 It shall come to pass in that day That the LORD will punish on high the host of exalted ones, And on the earth the kings of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:22: Isaiah 24:22 They will be gathered together, As prisoners are gathered in the pit, And will be shut up in the prison; After many days they will be punished.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 24:23: Isaiah 24:23 Then the moon will be disgraced And the sun ashamed; For the LORD of hosts will reign On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem And before His elders, gloriously.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:1: Isaiah 25:1 O LORD, You are my God.  I will exalt You, I will praise Your name,  For You have done wonderful things;  Your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:2: Isaiah 25:2 For You have made a city a ruin, A fortified city a ruin, A palace of foreigners to be a city no more; It will never be rebuilt.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:3: Isaiah 25:3 Therefore the strong people will glorify You; The city of the terrible nations will fear You.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:4: Isaiah 25:4 For You have been a strength to the poor, A strength to the needy in his distress,  A refuge from the storm, A shade from the heat; For the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:5: Isaiah 25:5 You will reduce the noise of aliens, As heat in a dry place; As heat in the shadow of a cloud, The song of the terrible ones will be diminished.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:6: Isaiah 25:6 And in this mountain  The LORD of hosts will make for all people A feast of choice pieces, A feast of wines on the lees, Of fat things full of marrow, Of well-refined wines on the lees.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:7: Isaiah 25:7 And He will destroy on this mountain The surface of the covering cast over all people, And the veil that is spread over all nations.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:8: Isaiah 25:8 He will swallow up death forever, And the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces; The rebuke of His people He will take away from all the earth; For the LORD has spoken.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:9: Isaiah 25:9 And it will be said in that day: "Behold, this is our God;  We have waited for Him, and He will save us. This is the LORD; We have waited for Him;  We will be glad and rejoice in His salvation."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:10: Isaiah 25:10 For on this mountain the hand of the LORD will rest, And Moab shall be trampled down under Him, As straw is trampled down for the refuse heap.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:11: Isaiah 25:11 And He will spread out His hands in their midst As a swimmer reaches out to swim, And He will bring down their pride Together with the trickery of their hands.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 25:12: Isaiah 25:12 The fortress of the high fort of your walls He will bring down, lay low, And bring to the ground, down to the dust.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:1: Isaiah 26:1 In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city;  God will appoint salvation for walls and bulwarks.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:2: Isaiah 26:2 Open the gates, That the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:3: Isaiah 26:3 You will keep him in perfect peace, Whose mind is stayed on You, Because he trusts in You.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:4: Isaiah 26:4 Trust in the LORD forever,  For in YAH, the LORD, is everlasting strength.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:5: Isaiah 26:5 For He brings down those who dwell on high,  The lofty city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He brings it down to the dust.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:6: Isaiah 26:6 The foot shall tread it down"” The feet of the poor And the steps of the needy."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:7: Isaiah 26:7 The way of the just is uprightness;  O Most Upright, You weigh the path of the just.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:8: Isaiah 26:8 Yes, in the way of Your judgments, O LORD, we have waited for You; The desire of our soul is for Your name And for the remembrance of You.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:9: Isaiah 26:9 With my soul I have desired You in the night, Yes, by my spirit within me I will seek You early; For when Your judgments are in the earth, The inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:10: Isaiah 26:10 Let grace be shown to the wicked, Yet he will not learn righteousness; In the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, And will not behold the majesty of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:11: Isaiah 26:11 LORD, when Your hand is lifted up, they will not see. But they will see and be ashamed For their envy of people; Yes, the fire of Your enemies shall devour them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:12: Isaiah 26:12 LORD, You will establish peace for us, For You have also done all our works in us.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:13: Isaiah 26:13 O LORD our God, masters besides You Have had dominion over us; But by You only we make mention of Your name.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:14: Isaiah 26:14 They are dead, they will not live; They are deceased, they will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And made all their memory to perish.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:15: Isaiah 26:15 You have increased the nation, O LORD, You have increased the nation; You are glorified; You have expanded all the borders of the land.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:16: Isaiah 26:16 LORD, in trouble they have visited You, They poured out a prayer when Your chastening was upon them.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:17: Isaiah 26:17 As a woman with child Is in pain and cries out in her pangs, When she draws near the time of her delivery, So have we been in Your sight, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:18: Isaiah 26:18 We have been with child, we have been in pain; We have, as it were, brought forth wind; We have not accomplished any deliverance in the earth, Nor have the inhabitants of the world fallen.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:19: Isaiah 26:19 Your dead shall live; Together with my dead body they shall arise.  Awake and sing, you who dwell in dust; For your dew is like the dew of herbs, And the earth shall cast out the dead.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:20: Isaiah 26:20 Come, my people, enter your chambers, And shut your doors behind you; Hide yourself, as it were, for a little moment, Until the indignation is past.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 26:21: Isaiah 26:21 For behold, the LORD comes out of His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; The earth will also disclose her blood, And will no more cover her slain.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:1: Isaiah 27:1 In that day the LORD with His severe sword, great and strong, Will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent,  Leviathan that twisted serpent; And He will slay the reptile that is in the sea.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:2: Isaiah 27:2 In that day sing to her,  "A vineyard of red wine!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:3: Isaiah 27:3 I, the LORD, keep it, I water it every moment; Lest any hurt it, I keep it night and day.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:4: Isaiah 27:4 Fury is not in Me. Who would set briers and thorns Against Me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:5: Isaiah 27:5 Or let him take hold of My strength, That he may make peace with Me; And he shall make peace with Me."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:6: Isaiah 27:6 Those who come He shall cause to take root in Jacob; Israel shall blossom and bud, And fill the face of the world with fruit.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:7: Isaiah 27:7 Has He struck Israel as He struck those who struck him? Or has He been slain according to the slaughter of those who were slain by Him?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:8: Isaiah 27:8 In measure, by sending it away, You contended with it.  He removes it by His rough wind In the day of the east wind.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:9: Isaiah 27:9 Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be covered; And this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: When he makes all the stones of the altar Like chalkstones that are beaten to dust, Wooden images and incense altars shall not stand.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:10: Isaiah 27:10 Yet the fortified city will be desolate, The habitation forsaken and left like a wilderness; There the calf will feed, and there it will lie down And consume its branches.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:11: Isaiah 27:11 When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off; The women come and set them on fire. For it is a people of no understanding; Therefore He who made them will not have mercy on them, And He who formed them will show them no favor.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:12: Isaiah 27:12 And it shall come to pass in that day That the LORD will thresh, From the channel of the River to the Brook of Egypt; And you will be gathered one by one, O you children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 27:13: Isaiah 27:13 So it shall be in that day:  The great trumpet will be blown; They will come, who are about to perish in the land of Assyria, And they who are outcasts in the land of Egypt, And shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:1: Isaiah 28:1 Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, Whose glorious beauty is a fading flower Which is at the head of the verdant valleys, To those who are overcome with wine!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:2: Isaiah 28:2 Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one,  Like a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, Like a flood of mighty waters overflowing, Who will bring them down to the earth with His hand.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:3: Isaiah 28:3 The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, Will be trampled underfoot;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:4: Isaiah 28:4 And the glorious beauty is a fading flower Which is at the head of the verdant valley, Like the first fruit before the summer, Which an observer sees; He eats it up while it is still in his hand.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:5: Isaiah 28:5 In that day the LORD of hosts will be For a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty To the remnant of His people,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:6: Isaiah 28:6 For a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, And for strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:7: Isaiah 28:7 But they also have erred through wine, And through intoxicating drink are out of the way;  The priest and the prophet have erred through intoxicating drink, They are swallowed up by wine, They are out of the way through intoxicating drink; They err in vision, they stumble in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:8: Isaiah 28:8 For all tables are full of vomit and filth; No place is clean.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:9: Isaiah 28:9 "Whom  will he teach knowledge? And whom will he make to understand the message? Those just weaned from milk? Those just drawn from the breasts?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:10: Isaiah 28:10 For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept, Line upon line, line upon line, Here a little, there a little."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:11: Isaiah 28:11 For with stammering lips and another tongue He will speak to this people,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:12: Isaiah 28:12 To whom He said, "This is the rest with which You may cause the weary to rest," And, "This is the refreshing"; Yet they would not hear.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:13: Isaiah 28:13 But the word of the LORD was to them, "Precept upon precept, precept upon precept, Line upon line, line upon line, Here a little, there a little," That they might go and fall backward, and be broken And snared and caught.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:14: Isaiah 28:14 Therefore hear the word of the LORD, you scornful men, Who rule this people who are in Jerusalem,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:15: Isaiah 28:15 Because you have said, "We have made a covenant with death, And with Sheol we are in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, It will not come to us,  For we have made lies our refuge, And under falsehood we have hidden ourselves."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:16: Isaiah 28:16 Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, I lay in Zion a stone for a foundation, A tried stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; Whoever believes will not act hastily.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:17: Isaiah 28:17 Also I will make justice the measuring line, And righteousness the plummet; The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, And the waters will overflow the hiding place.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:18: Isaiah 28:18 Your covenant with death will be annulled, And your agreement with Sheol will not stand; When the overflowing scourge passes through, Then you will be trampled down by it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:19: Isaiah 28:19 As often as it goes out it will take you; For morning by morning it will pass over, And by day and by night; It will be a terror just to understand the report."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:20: Isaiah 28:20 For the bed is too short to stretch out on, And the covering so narrow that one cannot wrap himself in it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:21: Isaiah 28:21 For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim, He will be angry as in the Valley of Gibeon"” That He may do His work, His awesome work, And bring to pass His act, His unusual act.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:22: Isaiah 28:22 Now therefore, do not be mockers, Lest your bonds be made strong; For I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts,  A destruction determined even upon the whole earth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:23: Isaiah 28:23 Give ear and hear my voice, Listen and hear my speech.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:24: Isaiah 28:24 Does the plowman keep plowing all day to sow? Does he keep turning his soil and breaking the clods?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:25: Isaiah 28:25 When he has leveled its surface, Does he not sow the black cummin And scatter the cummin, Plant the wheat in rows, The barley in the appointed place, And the spelt in its place?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:26: Isaiah 28:26 For He instructs him in right judgment, His God teaches him.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:27: Isaiah 28:27 For the black cummin is not threshed with a threshing sledge, Nor is a cartwheel rolled over the cummin; But the black cummin is beaten out with a stick, And the cummin with a rod.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:28: Isaiah 28:28 Bread flour must be ground; Therefore he does not thresh it forever, Break it with his cartwheel, Or crush it with his horsemen.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 28:29: Isaiah 28:29 This also comes from the LORD of hosts,  Who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in guidance.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:1: Isaiah 29:1 "Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! Add year to year; Let feasts come around.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:2: Isaiah 29:2 Yet I will distress Ariel; There shall be heaviness and sorrow, And it shall be to Me as Ariel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:3: Isaiah 29:3 I will encamp against you all around, I will lay siege against you with a mound, And I will raise siegeworks against you.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:4: Isaiah 29:4 You shall be brought down, You shall speak out of the ground; Your speech shall be low, out of the dust; Your voice shall be like a medium's, out of the ground; And your speech shall whisper out of the dust.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:5: Isaiah 29:5 "Moreover the multitude of your foes Shall be like fine dust, And the multitude of the terrible ones Like chaff that passes away; Yes, it shall be in an instant, suddenly.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:6: Isaiah 29:6 You will be punished by the LORD of hosts With thunder and earthquake and great noise, With storm and tempest And the flame of devouring fire.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:7: Isaiah 29:7 The multitude of all the nations who fight against Ariel, Even all who fight against her and her fortress, And distress her, Shall be as a dream of a night vision.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:8: Isaiah 29:8 It shall even be as when a hungry man dreams, And look"”he eats; But he awakes, and his soul is still empty; Or as when a thirsty man dreams, And look"”he drinks; But he awakes, and indeed he is faint, And his soul still craves: So the multitude of all the nations shall be, Who fight against Mount Zion."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:9: Isaiah 29:9 Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind!  They are drunk, but not with wine; They stagger, but not with intoxicating drink.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:10: Isaiah 29:10 For the LORD has poured out on you The spirit of deep sleep, And has closed your eyes, namely, the prophets; And He has covered your heads, namely, the seers.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:11: Isaiah 29:11 The whole vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is literate, saying, "Read this, please."  And he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:12: Isaiah 29:12 Then the book is delivered to one who is illiterate, saying, "Read this, please." And he says, "I am not literate."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:13: Isaiah 29:13 Therefore the Lord said:  "Inasmuch as these people draw near with their mouths And honor Me with their lips, But have removed their hearts far from Me, And their fear toward Me is taught by the commandment of men,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:14: Isaiah 29:14 Therefore, behold, I will again do a marvelous work Among this people, A marvelous work and a wonder;  For the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, And the understanding of their prudent men shall be hidden."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:15: Isaiah 29:15 Woe to those who seek deep to hide their counsel far from the LORD, And their works are in the dark;  They say, "Who sees us?" and, "Who knows us?"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:16: Isaiah 29:16 Surely you have things turned around! Shall the potter be esteemed as the clay; For shall the thing made say of him who made it, "He did not make me"? Or shall the thing formed say of him who formed it, "He has no understanding"?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:17: Isaiah 29:17 Is it not yet a very little while Till Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, And the fruitful field be esteemed as a forest?(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:18: Isaiah 29:18 In that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, And the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity and out of darkness.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:19: Isaiah 29:19 The humble also shall increase their joy in the LORD, And the poor among men shall rejoice In the Holy One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:20: Isaiah 29:20 For the terrible one is brought to nothing,  The scornful one is consumed, And all who watch for iniquity are cut off"”(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:21: Isaiah 29:21 Who make a man an offender by a word, And lay a snare for him who reproves in the gate, And turn aside the just by empty words.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:22: Isaiah 29:22 Therefore thus says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall not now be ashamed, Nor shall his face now grow pale;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:23: Isaiah 29:23 But when he sees his children,  The work of My hands, in his midst, They will hallow My name, And hallow the Holy One of Jacob, And fear the God of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 29:24: Isaiah 29:24 These also who erred in spirit will come to understanding, And those who complained will learn doctrine."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:1: Isaiah 30:1 "Woe to the rebellious children," says the LORD,  "Who take counsel, but not of Me, And who devise plans, but not of My Spirit,  That they may add sin to sin;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:2: Isaiah 30:2 Who walk to go down to Egypt, And have not asked My advice, To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:3: Isaiah 30:3 Therefore the strength of Pharaoh Shall be your shame, And trust in the shadow of Egypt Shall be your humiliation.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:4: Isaiah 30:4 For his princes were at Zoan, And his ambassadors came to Hanes.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:5: Isaiah 30:5 They were all ashamed of a people who could not benefit them, Or be help or benefit, But a shame and also a reproach."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:6: Isaiah 30:6 The burden against the beasts of the South. Through a land of trouble and anguish, From which came the lioness and lion,  The viper and fiery flying serpent, They will carry their riches on the backs of young donkeys, And their treasures on the humps of camels, To a people who shall not profit;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:7: Isaiah 30:7 For the Egyptians shall help in vain and to no purpose. Therefore I have called her Rahab-Hem-Shebeth.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:8: Isaiah 30:8 Now go, write it before them on a tablet, And note it on a scroll, That it may be for time to come, Forever and ever:(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:9: Isaiah 30:9 That this is a rebellious people, Lying children, Children who will not hear the law of the LORD;(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:10: Isaiah 30:10 Who say to the seers, "Do not see," And to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us right things;  Speak to us smooth things, prophesy deceits.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:11: Isaiah 30:11 Get out of the way, Turn aside from the path, Cause the Holy One of Israel To cease from before us."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:12: Isaiah 30:12 Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because you despise this word, And trust in oppression and perversity, And rely on them,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:13: Isaiah 30:13 Therefore this iniquity shall be to you  Like a breach ready to fall, A bulge in a high wall, Whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:14: Isaiah 30:14 And He shall break it like the breaking of the potter's vessel, Which is broken in pieces; He shall not spare. So there shall not be found among its fragments A shard to take fire from the hearth, Or to take water from the cistern."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:15: Isaiah 30:15 For thus says the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel:  "In returning and rest you shall be saved; In quietness and confidence shall be your strength."  But you would not,(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:16: Isaiah 30:16 And you said, "No, for we will flee on horses""” Therefore you shall flee! And, "We will ride on swift horses""” Therefore those who pursue you shall be swift!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:17: Isaiah 30:17 One thousand shall flee at the threat of one, At the threat of five you shall flee, Till you are left as a pole on top of a mountain And as a banner on a hill.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:18: Isaiah 30:18 Therefore the LORD will wait, that He may be gracious to you; And therefore He will be exalted, that He may have mercy on you. For the LORD is a God of justice;  Blessed are all those who wait for Him.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:19: Isaiah 30:19 For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem; You shall weep no more. He will be very gracious to you at the sound of your cry; When He hears it, He will answer you.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:20: Isaiah 30:20 And though the Lord gives you  The bread of adversity and the water of affliction, Yet your teachers will not be moved into a corner anymore, But your eyes shall see your teachers.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:21: Isaiah 30:21 Your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," Whenever you turn to the right hand Or whenever you turn to the left.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:22: Isaiah 30:22 You will also defile the covering of your images of silver, And the ornament of your molded images of gold. You will throw them away as an unclean thing;  You will say to them, "Get away!"(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:23: Isaiah 30:23 Then He will give the rain for your seed With which you sow the ground, And bread of the increase of the earth; It will be fat and plentiful. In that day your cattle will feed In large pastures.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:24: Isaiah 30:24 Likewise the oxen and the young donkeys that work the ground Will eat cured fodder, Which has been winnowed with the shovel and fan.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:25: Isaiah 30:25 There will be on every high mountain And on every high hill Rivers and streams of waters, In the day of the great slaughter, When the towers fall.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:26: Isaiah 30:26 Moreover the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, And the light of the sun will be sevenfold, As the light of seven days, In the day that the LORD binds up the bruise of His people And heals the stroke of their wound.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:27: Isaiah 30:27 Behold, the name of the LORD comes from afar, Burning with His anger, And His burden is heavy; His lips are full of indignation, And His tongue like a devouring fire.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:28: Isaiah 30:28 His breath is like an overflowing stream,  Which reaches up to the neck, To sift the nations with the sieve of futility; And there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, Causing them to err.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:29: Isaiah 30:29 You shall have a song As in the night when a holy festival is kept, And gladness of heart as when one goes with a flute, To come into the mountain of the LORD, To the Mighty One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:30: Isaiah 30:30 The LORD will cause His glorious voice to be heard, And show the descent of His arm, With the indignation of His anger And the flame of a devouring fire, With scattering, tempest, and hailstones.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:31: Isaiah 30:31 For through the voice of the LORD Assyria will be beaten down, As He strikes with the rod.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:32: Isaiah 30:32 And in every place where the staff of punishment passes, Which the LORD lays on him, It will be with tambourines and harps; And in battles of brandishing He will fight with it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 30:33: Isaiah 30:33 For Tophet was established of old, Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made it deep and large; Its pyre is fire with much wood; The breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, Kindles it.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:1: Isaiah 31:1 Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, And rely on horses, Who trust in chariots because they are many, And in horsemen because they are very strong, But who do not look to the Holy One of Israel,  Nor seek the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:2: Isaiah 31:2 Yet He also is wise and will bring disaster, And will not call back His words, But will arise against the house of evildoers, And against the help of those who work iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:3: Isaiah 31:3 Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; And their horses are flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, Both he who helps will fall, And he who is helped will fall down; They all will perish together.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:4: Isaiah 31:4 For thus the LORD has spoken to me:  "As a lion roars, And a young lion over his prey (When a multitude of shepherds is summoned against him, He will not be afraid of their voice Nor be disturbed by their noise), So the LORD of hosts will come down To fight for Mount Zion and for its hill.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:5: Isaiah 31:5 Like birds flying about, So will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem. Defending, He will also deliver it; Passing over, He will preserve it."(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:6: Isaiah 31:6 Return to Him against whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:7: Isaiah 31:7 For in that day every man shall throw away his idols of silver and his idols of gold"” sin, which your own hands have made for yourselves.(NKJV)
verses.isaiah 31:8: Isaiah 31:8 "Then Assyria shall fall by a sword not of man, And a sword not of mankind shall devour him. But he shall flee from the sword, And his young men shall become forced labor.(NKJV)
